s: Which State has the highest share of Buddhists in its population, as per Census 2011?

s: In which State were Muslims in a majority, at about 68% of the population, in Census 2011?

The arrival of Arab merchants on the western coast

s: Which of the following is associated with the early arrival of Islam in India?

s: In which year is St Thomas traditionally held to have brought Christianity to India?
x: St Thomas is linked to 52 AD; Portuguese and Francis Xavier came later.

Transfers all minority identification powers exclusively to State Commissions.
Requires every minority community to be identified only through a census conducted by the Supreme Court.
Prevents the Centre from notifying any minority community.

s: Who was appointed Chairperson of the National Commission for Minorities for a full three-year term in July 2026?

s: Which communities were notified as minorities in 1993?

s: How many communities are now notified as minorities under the NCM Act, 1992?

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the central minority scholarship schemes?

s: What is the Jiyo Parsi scheme intended to address?

The decline of the Parsi population
The infrastructure gap in Minority Concentration Areas

s: The Census 2027 enumeration schedule includes which of the following?
o: Only the six notified religions, without any parental information
The six religions plus ‘other religion’, along with the religion and birthplace of both parents
Only ‘No Religion’ and ‘Other Religion’, along with the birthplace of grandparents
The six religions plus caste, but no question on birthplace

s: In which State has a Uniform Civil Code been in force since January 2025?
x: Uttarakhand's UCC came into force in January 2025; Bills of Assam, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh were awaiting Presidential assent.

s: Which one of the following is NOT a provision or associated feature mentioned in relation to the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025 and UMEED?

Uploading property data on the UMEED portal within six months
Audit of waqfs earning over ₹1 lakh

s: What share of central minority scholarships is reserved for girls?
x: 30% of minority scholarships are for girls, not 50%.

s: What is the name of the portal on which waqf property data must be uploaded under the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025?
x: The Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025, in force from 8 April 2025, requires waqf property data on the UMEED portal.
